comparison.objective: Seat and tighten a positive battery-terminal clamp while preserving cable-lug alignment, versus set and lock a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1947 holds/seats a clamp and operates one wrench; the candidate simultaneously seats a hex driver and open-end wrench on a coupled screw and jam nut to oppose tightening torque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1947 requires a seated, torqued clamp, aligned lug, safe wrench removal, and an unmoved battery; the candidate additionally requires a retained target angle over repeated actuation.
comparison.reason: Although both involve tightening without disturbing alignment, battery-clamp installation does not test locking a continuous adjustment through coaxial countertorque and subsequent motion cycles.
